outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustration of the experimental workflow, not a plot showing averaged data.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA levels shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on each bar (n=4 per group).
Tumor volume quantification is shown as a dot plot with each individual tumor represented as a point, with mean and 95% CI overlaid.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA levels shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on each bar (n=4 per group).
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with error bars (SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlaying them would make the plot unreadable.
Panel F includes a micrograph and an accompanying bar chart quantifying CD4 intensity, which shows individual data points as dots overlaid on the bars.
Panel G includes a micrograph and an accompanying bar chart quantifying pERK intensity, which shows individual data points as dots overlaid on the bars.
